messages:
anya (Design): Uploaded an alternate compact rules layout that uses a left-aligned priority rail instead of chips. Preview: https://internal.redwood.dev/preview/rail-layout

ben (Product): Interesting. Does the rail help scanability on narrow screens?

anya (Design): Meant to — priority stays visually anchored while rule content scrolls. It also frees horizontal space for condition badges.

leo (Eng): Are we adding keyboard focus to the rail items? Need clear focus outline and aria roles.

elaine (A11y): Yes please. Rail items should be buttons with aria-pressed and an accessible label like "Priority 1: highest". Also ensure contrast for the rail numbers meets AA.

ben (Product): Noted a small mismatch between the simulator preview and rule counts after reordering. Could be stale cache.

leo (Eng): I'll make the reorder API invalidate the simulator cache on success. Also adding a 300ms debounce to the reorder requests to avoid spurious conflicts.

anya (Design): Small copy ask: can we add helper microcopy under the rail: "Drag handles or use Alt+Up/Alt+Down to reorder" so keyboard users know.

elaine (A11y): Include the keyboard shortcuts in the accessibility help modal and as a tooltip on the reorder control. And make sure Space toggles expansion but doesn't skip focus into the next row.

ui-bot: Image uploaded: rail-compact-v1.png

leo (Eng): Also switching the compact thumbnail to SVG icons reduced layout shift. Will push patch after a11y signoff.

anya (Design): Great. I'll tweak contrast and push two variant images for choice. Thanks team!
